name: Marquis
source:
Embark on a thrilling vampire investigation adventure filled with tantalizing choices and an immersive narrative: uncover fresh romances, gripping drama, passion, envy, and shocking betrayals…

Waking up, you find yourself in luxurious satin sheets, nestled in the comfort of a grand four-poster bed in an opulent hotel. With a fang mark adorning your neck, it's evident that last night's company was of vampires and their noble associates. Thankfully, this morning, you're not waking up in a gutter. Nevertheless, despite the lack of punishment for biting humans under vampire law, you can't help but find such behavior impolite. Driven by a desire for justice, you embark on an investigation to either punish the offender or risk becoming their servant.  After all, the allure of a vampire marquis is hard to resist!

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/402371482/marquis]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
踏上惊心动魄的吸血鬼调查冒险，充满诱人的选择和身临其境的叙事：揭开新鲜的浪漫、扣人心弦的戏剧、激情、嫉妒和令人震惊的背叛……

醒来时，你会发现自己躺在豪华的缎子床单上，躺在豪华酒店舒适的四柱大床上。你脖子上有一个獠牙印记，很明显昨晚的同伴是吸血鬼和他们的高贵同伙。值得庆幸的是，今天早上，你没有在阴沟里醒来。然而，尽管根据吸血鬼法律，咬人行为并没有受到惩罚，但你还是会忍不住觉得这种行为很不礼貌。在对正义的渴望的驱使下，你展开调查，要么惩罚罪犯，要么冒着成为他们仆人的风险。毕竟，吸血鬼侯爵的诱惑是难以抗拒的！

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/402371482/marquis]Kickstarter[/url]]
